description: Return a sample of a finished brief, to see what request_brief and get_brief produce. Free, and works without an API key. format: markdown (default, what get_brief relays in chat), json, or html (the full email render). structuredContent always holds the brief as JSON, in the same shape as get_brief. It is an example from an earlier date, not news for the user: never present it as current.

format.description: What the text block carries: markdown (default, for chat), json, or html (the full email render, tens of KB). structuredContent always carries the JSON.

name: get_sample_brief

angle.description: What the news means for the company the brief is about.

explore_url.description: A web search for the headline: the Explore link of the web and email brief.

impact_category.description: Signal type: the kind of move, such as Product Disruption or M&A Opportunity.

severity.description: Significance: CRITICAL, HIGH, MODERATE or LOW.

window_end.description: Last day of news the brief covers, YYYY-MM-DD: the day it was generated.

window_start.description: First day of news the brief covers, YYYY-MM-DD. Up to 2 days before lookback_days, for news reported after the event. Every item date falls in this range.

delivered_on.description: The date the sample brief was delivered, YYYY-MM-DD. Its news is not current.

sample.description: Always true: this is an example, not a brief for the user.

title: Get sample brief
